top_signals.title: Mark Walter’s TWG Says ‘There Has Been No Fraud’
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." TWG Global, the holding company at the heart of Mark Walter’s empire, defended itself against what it called “multipronged attacks” on its business as regulators and US prosecutors continue to probe the firm. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Republicans are dismissing affordability. That could be a problem in November
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump quipped that affordability was "devised" by Democrats, while Vice President JD Vance said groceries "cost what they cost."
